qualifier: growth control via nephrogenic progenitor proliferation
name: Kidney growth control via nephrogenic progenitor proliferation
rationale: All members regulate kidney/metanephros development, size or the proliferation and maintenance of its progenitors, whereas confusables centre on mesenchymal differentiation, apoptosis, nephric duct or ureter formation.

qualifier: with Rett-associated sensory, vocal and social behavior
name: MECP2 regulation and associated sensory, vocal, social behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 molecular function (DNA/corepressor binding, HDAC deacetylation, target genes) with the sensory, vocal, social and striatal phenotypes it governs; confusables carry either the molecular half or the behavioral half alone.

qualifier: nephric duct and ureter morphogenesis
name: Kidney development regulation with nephric duct and ureter morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate kidney, mesonephros and metanephros development together with nephric duct, epithelial tube and ureter formation, lacking the ureteric bud branching of some confusables and the proliferation/apoptosis control of others.

qualifier: self-renewal and stem cell division
name: Hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal and population maintenance
rationale: Members control HSC proliferation, division, homeostasis and restraint of differentiation (including LIF-driven stem cell maintenance), whereas confusables cover committed erythroid, megakaryocyte or myeloid differentiation.

qualifier: AV node, His bundle and Purkinje conduction
name: Cardiomyocyte depolarization along AV node–His–Purkinje conduction path
rationale: All members concern membrane depolarization in atrial, ventricular and AV nodal cells and signal propagation through His-Purkinje fibres, whereas confusables cover repolarization phases, potassium channels or SA node pacemaking.

core: GPCR–cAMP regulation of islet hormone secretion
qualifier: peptide-hormone receptors (incretin, glucagon, calcitonin/amylin, somatostatin)
name: Peptide-hormone GPCR–cAMP regulation of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are GPCR families (incretin, glucagon-type, calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, somatostatin, fatty-acid receptors) and adenylate cyclase/cAMP signaling that tune insulin, glucagon and GH secretion, unlike confusables built on adrenergic inhibition, KATP channels or intracellular fuel metabolism.

qualifier: granulocyte and mast cell lineages
name: Granulocyte-lineage differentiation from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation and commitment toward neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell fates under G-CSF/GM-CSF and granulopoietic transcription factors while restraining monocyte/macrophage fate, unlike confusables centred on erythroid-megakaryocyte or monocyte-macrophage-dendritic lineages.

qualifier: vocal learning, sensory gating and striatum/amygdala development
name: Sensory, vocal and social behavior; striatal–amygdalar development
rationale: Members are sensory-driven, vocal, social and psychomotor behaviors with the striatal and amygdalar circuits underlying them, distinct from confusables built on MECP2 molecular events, mating/pheromone behavior or locomotor/motor control.

qualifier: omega-3-derived resolvins and protectins
name: Omega-3-derived resolvin and protectin biosynthesis
rationale: Every member is biosynthesis of a DHA/EPA-derived resolvin or protectin, whereas confusables cover arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs, hepoxilins and leukotriene catabolism.

qualifier: tract-level pathfinding of commissural and projection neurons
name: Tract-level axon pathfinding of commissural and projection neurons
rationale: Members describe axon guidance at the level of specific tracts and neuron types (commissural, retinal, dopaminergic, serotonergic, corticospinal) including midline repulsion, while confusables are dominated by the underlying SLIT-ROBO, netrin and ephrin signaling machinery.

qualifier: centred on androgen receptor and prostate
name: Sex-steroid receptor response centred on androgen and prostate
rationale: Members are steroid hormone receptor responses (androgen and estrogen hallmarks, HSP90 receptor chaperoning) with an androgen/AR-prostate focus, distinguishing them from confusables centred on estrogen/progesterone receptor signaling or RUNX2 bone regulation.

qualifier: FcεRI-triggered calcium mobilization
name: Mast cell degranulation via FcεRI calcium mobilization
rationale: Members concern mast cell activation, degranulation, histamine release and type I hypersensitivity driven by FcεRI/LAT2 calcium signaling, while confusables cover FcεRI MAPK/NF-kB branches or eosinophil/Th2 immunity.

qualifier: COPII cargo loading and vesicle tethering
name: COPII-mediated ER-to-Golgi cargo loading and vesicle tethering
rationale: All members are steps of anterograde COPII vesicle transport from ER exit sites to the Golgi, including cargo concentration, coating, targeting and tethering, whereas confusables are COPI-mediated retrograde or intra-Golgi traffic.

qualifier: interleukins and T-helper/Treg responses
name: Negative regulation of inflammatory and T-cell interleukin production
rationale: Members mostly suppress production of interleukins (IL-1b, IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21) and TNF-family cytokines and Th1/Treg responses, unlike confusables centred on T cell proliferation/interferon suppression or TLR/NF-kB signal inhibition.

qualifier: salvage and catabolism rather than de novo synthesis
name: Purine salvage and nucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members cover PRPP-dependent purine base/nucleoside salvage (APRT, HPRT1) and nucleoside breakdown (ADA, PNP, inosine, adenosine, allantoin), distinct from confusables on de novo purine synthesis or deoxynucleotide triphosphate turnover.

qualifier: nicotinic and G-protein-gated channels
name: Nicotinic and G-protein-gated channel modulation of synaptic excitability
rationale: Members are channel-level controls of pre-, post- and extrasynaptic membrane potential (nicotinic receptors, GIRK, Gβγ inhibition of Ca2+ channels, presynaptic kainate, extrasynaptic GABA), with nicotinic receptors absent from all glutamatergic/presynaptic confusables.

qualifier: TCA-intermediate carboxylates and malate-aspartate shuttle
name: TCA-intermediate carboxylate and organic ion membrane transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of organic anions and cations, especially di/tricarboxylates, pyruvate and the malate-aspartate shuttle, distinguishing them from confusables on amino acid, carnitine or monocarboxylate transport.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 in T cells
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 γc cytokine signaling in T cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 receptor signaling and T cell activation via STAT5, distinct from confusables on IL-3/IL-5/IL-6 family signaling or IL-15/IL-21 NK-cell signaling.

qualifier: dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular junction
name: Skeletal muscle differentiation, dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members cover myogenesis, muscle homeostasis, diaphragm development, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex/ECM linkage and NMJ assembly, unlike confusables on sarcomere contraction, DAG1 glycosylation, atrophy or basement membrane.

qualifier: endocytosis, synaptic vesicle cycling and lysosome-related organelles
name: Clathrin-coated vesicle cycling and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members concern clathrin/adaptor coat assembly, cargo loading and uncoating in endocytosis and synaptic vesicle recycling, plus biogenesis of melanosomes and platelet dense granules, distinct from confusables on active zone structure, Golgi lysosomal sorting or mitochondrial tethering.

qualifier: cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis, transport and receptors
name: Cysteinyl leukotriene and allergic eicosanoid signaling
rationale: Members cover cysteinyl leukotriene (LTC4/LTD4) synthesis, export, receptors and IL-4 induction, plus prostaglandin D response, unlike confusables on LTB4/lipoxin catabolism or histamine/prostanoid receptor clusters.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar synthesis, Golgi transport and GPI anchors
name: Glycosylation donor supply: nucleotide-sugar synthesis, transport and GPI
rationale: Members synthesize or transport glycosylation donors (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucuronate, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid via SLC35 and related transporters, with their CDG defects) and build GPI anchors, distinct from confusables on dolichol N-glycan assembly, glycosphingolipids and O-glycans.

qualifier: complex III-IV transfer and complex IV assembly
name: Distal respiratory chain electron transfer and complex IV assembly
rationale: Members cover electron transfer from ubiquinol through cytochrome c to oxygen, chemiosmotic ATP formation, and cytochrome c oxidase/respirasome assembly, distinct from confusables on complex I/III assembly or mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: blood-group antigens and selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood-group and selectin-ligand glycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover fucose metabolism and synthesis of ABO/Lewis oligosaccharides and the sulfated fucosylated ligands that mediate leukocyte rolling and HSC homing, distinct from confusables on O-glycan initiation, N-glycan processing and sialylation.

qualifier: ER-associated degradation and reticulophagy
name: ER-associated misfolded protein quality control and degradation
rationale: Members address recognition, unfolding and disposal of misfolded proteins via ERAD regulation, reticulophagy and Josephin deubiquitinases, distinct from confusables on aggrephagy, stress granules, ribosome-associated QC or ubiquitin chain types.
